topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Ran into Molly today, or what's left of her since she got the word. Best friend's up and moving, clear across the country. She's all wound up, pacing her place like it's the last bit of solid ground. I tried to keep it cool, told her change is just the city's way of reminding you it's still spinning. But the way she clung to that cup of cold coffee, you'd think it was a lifeline. Someone's got to keep the world from spinning her off into the dark. I haven't slept since, cigarettes and thoughts smoldering into the night.某种程度的话，我明白那些未说出口的恐惧。We all hold on to something, but the city's got a way of making you let go.
